opinions.text: Motion of Michael Render, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of Cato Institute, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of Art Scholars and Historians for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania, Western District denied.
